experiment: W-05: the start wind as a function of the geometric scale factor
evidence_level: E0 (model against model; the K2 cross-check is the only independent element)
definition: start wind = the lowest constant wind speed (m/s) at which the crank completes one full revolution within 40 s from rest; bracket by doubling plus geometric bisection to 5 %; the result is the interval (lo, hi] (docs/EXPERIMENTS.md section 28)

scaling_rules.lengths: unit, body_length, lateral_spacing, foot_radius x L
scaling_rules.masses: body_mass x L**p; tube_mass_per_m x L**(p-1) so that a bar's mass is L**p; min_bar_mass x L**p
scaling_rules.sail: sail_area x L**2; sail_radius x L; sail_gear unchanged (dimensionless)
scaling_rules.servo: kp, kv, max_torque x L**(p+1) (they hold the weight during settle)
scaling_rules.not_scaled: crank_friction 0.002 N*m, crank_damping 0.001 N*m*s/rad, rotor_inertia 1e-4 kg*m^2 (absolute defaults); joint_friction and joint_damping default 0 (ideal); body_drag_area 0
scaling_rules.manufacturing: bar_width_mm / bar_thickness_mm only feed Design.bar_mass_per_m(); tube_mass_per_m is overridden, so the printed cross-section does not set the mass (it still sets the visual bar radius)

prediction.formula: v(L) = A * L**((p-2)/2) + B * L, with A = v_ref - B and B = (2*pi/T) * gear * sail_radius
prediction.v_ref_source: EXPERIMENTS.md section 28 (W-03): the unscaled walker needs (0.479, 0.500] m/s

load_models.lift: the load torque (raising the machine) is L**(p+1): slope (p-2)/2
load_models.pin_friction_weight: WIND.md section 4 premise (friction ~ normal force ~ weight): also L**(p+1): slope (p-2)/2
load_models.pin_friction_absolute: as coded (absolute Coulomb torque per pin): L**0: slope -1.5 (sign corrected on 2026-10-21; the pre-registration wrote +1.5)
load_models.time_criterion: the 40 s criterion adds omega_req*gear*r ~ L: slope 1
